name: frontend-spec-plugin
description: Collects missing PRD, prototype, and API inputs before turning a frontend feature request into an implementation-ready specification.

interface.longDescription: A frontend-focused specification pipeline that requires explicit confirmation of where frontend-spec will be created, then collects missing requirement, prototype, and API inputs and creates or resumes an isolated feature specification without scanning the surrounding project or mixing independent requirements.
defaultPrompt: Add a frontend feature. First ask me for any missing PRD, prototype, API inputs, and the exact frontend-spec output location.
Design this frontend feature and ask me to confirm where frontend-spec should be created before writing files.
Ask me to confirm the frontend-spec output path, then turn my requirement, UI prototype, and API contract into an isolated specification without mixing existing features.
